summary.text: Jessica Drew-Day is the Republican candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 33, and a businesswoman who has worked in film, television commercials, corporate videos and special events.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 9, 2026, and faces incumbent Democrat Carol Hagan McEntee in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Drew-Day earned a bachelor's degree from Johnson & Wales University in 2002.
